named_premises: Goodness is computed as total weighted positive coherence contribution P minus λ times total weighted negative coherence contribution H, i.e. F = P - λH.
The action has equal positive and negative effects: P = H > 0.
The harm penalty factor satisfies λ > 1.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Harm-aversion/optimization property of the F6 Goodness metric: equal positive and negative coherence effects are net-negative when λ > 1.

obstructions.reason: The derivation stops at the transition from P-IMAGO's analogical participation of creaturely goodness in God's goodness to the quantitative claim that goodness equals a weighted net sum of measurable coherence changes with an objective λ>1 harm penalty.
